summary: Become a certified ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer. Equip yourself with the tools to lead information security projects and enhance organizational resilience.
audienceIntro: This ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course is designed for AI and governance professionals who need to lead the implementation and ongoing management of an artificial intelligence management system within their organization or for clients.
audience: Information security and AI compliance officers
modules: AIMS Planning, Context, and AI Risk Management
Implementing AI Controls and AIMS Operations
prerequisites: The main prerequisite for this ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer course is a general knowledge of artificial intelligence management systems and the ISO/IEC 42001 standard. You should already be familiar with core AI concepts, typical AI project lifecycles, and how AI is deployed in your organization or clients. Prior exposure to management system standards (such as ISO-based governance, risk, and compliance frameworks) is helpful but not mandatory. No programming or model-building skills are required, as the focus is on implementing and managing an AIMS rather than engineering AI algorithms.
